intent: Replace disjointed locomotion with an eight-frame Eula-referenced run cycle; preserve approved Furina slender proportions.

references.role: Leg-cycle contact, compression, passing and short-flight continuity only
Master identity and slender head/body proportions
Approved production render style, costume, asymmetric leg identity

attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent RGBA sprite sheet for a side-scrolling action game.
Create a NEW Furina RUN CYCLE, exactly 8 consecutive animation frames, strict 2 rows by 4 columns, reading order left to right then second row. Large landscape canvas, each cell equal size, broad transparent padding. No text, labels, grid lines, ground lines, background, floor shadows or FX.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 (Eula run.png) is ONLY the leg-motion and animation continuity reference: study her smoothly coordinated hip, thigh, knee, ankle and foot transitions. Do not copy Eula's body, hair, costume, huge sword, or rigid sword-holding arms.
Image 2 (Furina portrait.png) is the MASTER IDENTITY and slender anatomical proportion reference. Reproduce Furina's face, small head relative to body, silver/blue short hair, ornate blue hat, blue/black/white gold-trimmed tailcoat, shorts, gloves, asymmetrical stockings and boots exactly.
Image 3 (Furina jab-thrust-proportions.png) locks the approved production sprite rendering style and lean body proportions. The sword is STOWED and NOT VISIBLE during this running cycle, so both arms move naturally.

CAMERA AND MODEL: all eight frames show the exact same Furina, at exactly the same scale, with fixed side-view facing RIGHT, a slight 3/4 angle matching Eula's clear sideward locomotion. No turn toward viewer and no perspective rotation. Each frame's pelvis/hip center stays at precisely the same horizontal center within its cell. Head and hat remain the same size in every frame; proportions remain slender, not chibi or big-headed. Motion is mostly legs with very slight pelvis bob and small natural shoulder counter-rotation. Keep identical costume detailing, exactly two arms and two legs, believable consistent anatomy.

CRUCIAL LEG IDENTITY: Furina's camera-near RIGHT leg is the BARE SKIN leg; her camera-far LEFT leg has the opaque BLACK THIGH-HIGH stocking. The bare leg and black leg MUST genuinely exchange front/back position halfway through the cycle. NEVER recolor the leading leg instead of moving the legs. Black stocking is always on anatomical LEFT leg, bare skin always on anatomical RIGHT leg.

GAIT: a light, confident practical small-stride RUN, not dance, not catwalk, not march, not exaggerated high-knee skip. Feet travel smoothly forward then backward relative to the hips like Eula. Show distinct contact, compression, passing/recovery and short flight phases on BOTH legs. Comfortable slight forward body lean, moderate knee lift, controlled push-off, low bounce; no excessively wide split. Arms swing modestly opposite the legs with bent elbows, naturally alternate across the half-cycle, no hand stuck on hat or chest. Hat and hair remain secure; coat tails and ribbons follow a subtle consistent trailing wave and must not obscure knees, ankles or feet.

EXACT PHASES:
1. RIGHT CONTACT: bare near right leg reaches forward and boot touches the common imaginary ground; stocking far left leg extends behind starting recovery. Opposite arm forward.
2. RIGHT COMPRESSION: bare right leg bends under the body accepting weight; stocking left heel folds up behind.
3. RIGHT PASSING: bare right support leg passes underneath/back beneath pelvis; stocking left knee swings forward under the hips, feet pass each other without fusing.
4. LEFT PRE-CONTACT / SHORT FLIGHT: stocking left leg is forward extending toward next contact, bare right leg is rear after push-off. Both feet just slightly above the ground, natural low flight.
5. LEFT CONTACT: stocking far left leg now reaches forward to contact; bare near right leg extends behind. This must visibly be the OPPOSITE stride from frame 1.
6. LEFT COMPRESSION: stocking left leg bends under the body accepting weight; bare right heel folds up behind.
7. LEFT PASSING: stocking left support leg passes under/back beneath pelvis; bare right knee swings forward, feet pass without fusing.
8. RIGHT PRE-CONTACT / SHORT FLIGHT: bare right leg is forward extending toward next contact, stocking left leg rear after push-off. Both feet slightly airborne. Frame 8 flows seamlessly to frame 1.

LAYOUT: same imaginary ground baseline within each equal cell, around 93% down the cell. Contact boots touch this same baseline; flight boots rise a small natural amount ABOVE it, do not move the entire sprite down to fake contact. The pelvis x center remains fixed. Full hat, ribbons, tails and both boots entirely inside each cell, generous gap between frames; no neighboring overlap or cropped extremities. Clean polished Japanese fantasy game sprite art, sharp readable silhouettes and painted details matching the approved Furina art. Genuine transparent alpha background.
attempts.review: True alternating legs and stable hip/camera achieved, frame 6 rear folded right leg incorrectly black instead of bare.
